LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.3: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: where one is going (e.g. 你去 哪儿 Nǐ qù nǎr?, 老师去哪儿了? Lǎoshī qù nǎr le?, 老师在...吗? Lǎoshī zài ......ma?), What strategies can you use to read texts clearly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner contributes to group decision making when they participate actively in

identifying key vocabulary from the word puzzle.

Values:
The learner displays team spirit as they work with peers to read texts and provide appropriate answers to the given questions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer education and Mentorship: These are developed when the learner takes responsibility of their literacy skills by forming

reading book clubs to learn from each other’s experiences.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner relates the skills of giving locations and positions of items or things using the appropriate words to their learning in

English and Kiswahili.
